name: Bartimaeus
summary: A blind beggar, the son of Timaeus, who sat by the road outside Jericho. He cried out to Jesus for mercy, and Jesus gave him his sight.

key_moments.title: Crying Out by the Road
key_moments.description: As Jesus left Jericho, blind Bartimaeus heard it was Jesus of Nazareth and cried out to the Son of David for mercy. Many told him to be quiet, but he cried out even more.

key_moments.title: Receiving His Sight
key_moments.description: Jesus called for him, and he threw off his coat and came. He asked to receive his sight, Jesus told him his faith had made him whole, and he could see at once and followed Jesus.
